description: Defines the EndOfDayBalance class which models daily balance data and interest calculations for savings accounts in the Fineract project.

classes.name: EndOfDayBalance
classes.description: Represents the end-of-day balance for a savings account, including methods for interest calculation and balance period management.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Factory method to create an EndOfDayBalance instance.

methods.name: date
methods.description: Returns the date of the balance record.

methods.name: cumulativeBalance
methods.description: Calculates the cumulative balance for interest purposes.

methods.name: calculateInterestOnBalance
methods.description: Calculates interest based on the balance and interest rate parameters.

methods.name: calculateInterestOnBalanceAndInterest
methods.description: Calculates future value interest considering compounding.

methods.name: upTo
methods.description: Returns a new EndOfDayBalance up to a specified date interval.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if the balance period contains a given date interval.

methods.name: getNumberOfDays
methods.description: Returns the number of days in the balance period.
